_about.purpose: GOLDEN-LABELS kind (free text) -> DocumentType, and label system -> platform system code, for the M6 offline shadow evaluation (backend/scripts/m6_shadow_eval.py). Data, reviewed entry by entry; a kind with no faithful type is unmapped (type null) with the reason, never guessed.
_about.reviewed_by: ep-implementer (Claude Opus 5.5), ORCH-043, 2026-10-08; owner countersignature not claimed
conventions: SHOP_DRAWING: a shop drawing cover or sheet (any contractor of our systems' chain); an interior-design shop drawing of another contractor's package is unmapped (the taxonomy's SHOP_DRAWING / IFC_DRAWING carry a provenance neither fits).

IFC_DRAWING: a consultant's issued-for-construction sheet or set. A tender / IFT drawing is unmapped: the taxonomy has no type for it, and the rules' OTHER for tender drawings is a convention, not a truth.
DRAWING: a drawing whose provenance the label does not state.
OTHER: a document of none of the named types (letters, calculations, O&M manuals, minutes, orders, BOQs).
A kind that could be either of two types (a quotation of ours not attached as a Design Sheet; a letter that may stand as a certificate) is unmapped.
_about.system_codes: FAS (fire alarm, its voice evacuation), PAVA, ELS (emergency lighting, central battery), FRC (fire-rated cables), NONE (labelled as another discipline); null = excluded from system accuracy
